candidates.title: Mistral releases the open weights of an improved Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"): 1T-parameter natively multimodal MoE (49B active per token, 52B incl. embeddings), 1M context, trained from scratch, under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License
candidates.reason: Weighted 81.2 >= 80. Verified against primary sources: Mistral blog post (datePublished 2026-10-29T12:00:07Z, in window) read in full; Hugging Face API shows the repo was created privately 2026-09-30 and its first public commit "Initial release" is 2026-10-29T14:11:16Z (in window), ~1.06 TB used storage, plus an NVFP4 checkpoint; model card and LICENSE read (modified MIT; Model-as-a-Service businesses need a separate commercial licence); official @MistralAI post 14:21:24Z; transformers v5.22.0 release (14:15:39Z) adds the architecture; NVIDIA day-0 NVFP4/Dynamo post 14:46:44Z. The Oct 6 preview post (API only, weights promised for end of month) is the earlier announcement; the weights and the improved RL checkpoint are new in this window. Benchmarks (FrontierCode 2.0 19.7%, Terminal-Bench 4.0 41%, AA Coding Agent Index 48%, AA Cyber Index 51%) are as presented by Mistral, partly from third-party evaluators, not reproduced by AgentLab; the model was not run (codeStatus not_run).
